subject: System Design
title: Data Sovereignty and Compliance
description: A 60-second lesson on Data Sovereignty and Compliance.

hook.text: GDPR says European user data must stay in Europe. Your US servers can't touch it.

buildup.text: Data sovereignty laws dictate where data can be stored and processed geographically.

discovery.text: Compliance requires geo-fenced databases, regional encryption keys, and audit-ready data flows.

twist.text: Global systems must shard by region for compliance, not just performance. This adds architectural complexity.

climax.text: Data sovereignty turns a technical scaling decision into a legal and political constraint.

punchline.text: Where data lives is a legal decision, not just technical.

quiz.question: What does data sovereignty require?
options: Data stored and processed within specific geographic boundaries
